text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-piii~~ Trai-pi, Trai-piii~~~~...! I 
finally get to see youuu~~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So last night! I couldn't fall asleep at 
all, right? I thought, 'welp, time to 
scroll on my phone'—and then!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My messages are left on unread, too? 
Nothing's moving on my feed, either? 
Everyone's asleep...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was like, "I'm the most lonely person in 
the entire universe!!" I was literally 
crying...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After experiencing loneliness in the 
middle of the night by a strange twist of 
fate, Daitaku Helios seemed to have 
suffered from a lack of sleep...
